designationHistory.name: Passage Key Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: President Theodore Roosevelt established the Passage Key Reservation by executive order on October 10, 1905, as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds.

authority.citation: Executive Order of Oct. 10, 1905 (unnumbered; listed as 357-B)

designationHistory.indexOriginal: President Theodore Roosevelt established Passage Key NWR in 1905 to preserve nesting colonies of native seabirds and wading birds.
